Context: Conditions for grant of benefits :

(GP { 4,200) in Department of Posts, who was granted 1st MACP in the Grade Pay of { 4,600 in PB-2, he will now be granted (Grade Pay of { 4,800 in the pay band PB-2) Level 8 of the Pay Matrix consequent upon upgradation of the post of Postal Inspector from GP of { 4,200 to GP of { 4,600 / Level 7 in the Pay Matrix.
